topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I've been reflecting on something I noticed recently, and it's been weighing on me. My neighbor, whom we've known only as the quiet type, has suddenly been making these lavish upgrades to his home. A brand new car, a beautifully landscaped garden, and recently, he threw a dinner party where the guest list and the menu spoke volumes of a lifestyle I never imagined. It's strange, to realize there's so much we don't know about the people we see every day. I find myself wondering, how many other secrets does this quiet street hold? It's almost as if the neighborhood has changed, but the only change was in what we now see.
